title: Web UI + API: priority sort, shortId badge, drag&drop reorder, elastic-input search
summary: Web UI + API: sort per priority, badge shortId, drag&drop reorder, detail shortId, search bar elastic-input.
description:
## Scope
`packages/plan-web-ui` + API server (`packages/plan-server`). Sort per priority, badge shortId, drag&drop reorder, detail page shortId, search bar elastic-input.

## File da modificare
- `packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/types.ts` — aggiungere `shortId: string` e `priority: number` a Feature/Phase/Task.
- `packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/dashboard-tree.ts:buildWorkTree` — sort per `priority ASC, number ASC, createdAt ASC` (sostituisce sort per number; feature, phase, task).
- `packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts` — `displayedWorkTree` ordina per priority; stato query search + mappa AST→filtri.
- `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx` + `work-tree-rows.tsx`:
  - Badge mostra `F001 · UUXD1` (composite + shortId, entrambi copyable).
  - **Drag-and-drop** con `@dnd-kit/core` + `@dnd-kit/sortable`: riordino entro lo stesso scope (task dentro phase, phase dentro feature, feature nel project). On drop → ricalcola gap (10,20,30) → chiama API bulk reorder.
  - Highlight match quando search attiva.
- `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/*-detail/route.tsx` — header mostra shortId copyable.
- API (`packages/plan-server/src/`):
  - `PATCH /api/tasks/:id/priority` (e phase/feature) — update priority singolo.
  - `POST /api/tasks/reorder` (e phase/feature) — bulk reorder con array di id nell'ordine desiderato → riassegna gap.
  - WebSocket event su reorder → refresh live.
- Search bar (`elastic-input`):
  - Nuovo componente `components/dashboard/search-bar.tsx` con `fields` = [feature(number), phase(number), task(number), status(enum), title(string), id(shortId)].
  - `fetchSuggestions` per number/shortId/title dal piano caricato.
  - `onSearch(query, ast)` → parser AST → filtri useDashboardTree + shortIds set.
  - Posizionata sopra il Work Tree; quando attiva filtra l'albero a rami matchanti + auto-expand + highlight.

## Dipendenze nuove (package.json plan-web-ui)
- `@dnd-kit/core`, `@dnd-kit/sortable` (MIT, ~30KB gz).
- `elastic-input` (MIT, zero sub-deps).
- Aggiornare `scripts/copy-web-ui.sh` se necessario (invariato: copia solo assets/).

## Comportamenti da preservare
- Filtri status esistenti (hide-done, hide-planned, only-active, status chips) si combinano in AND con la search.
- Composite F00x/P00x/T00x resta visibile e copyable.
- Mobile responsive (badge sopra title, wrap, 0 overflow a 390px) — le nuove aggiunte devono rispettarlo.

## Criteri di completamento
- `pnpm -r build` + `pnpm check` verdi.
- Verifica Puppeteer 390px: 0 overflow, badge shortId visibile, drag handle tap-target ≥44px.
- Test funzionale: drag task → ordine persiste dopo reload; search `id:UUXD1` → 1 match; search `task:10,12,3` → 3 match; search `title:auth` → match substring.

## Dipendenze
- Fase 1 (Core) + Fase 2 (Adapters) completate.

## File
`packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/dashboard-tree.ts:buildWorkTree`, `packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts`

## Cosa fare
- `buildWorkTree`: sort features per `priority ASC, number ASC, createdAt ASC` (sostituisce `left.feature.number - right.feature.number`). Sort phases dentro feature per priority. Sort tasks dentro phase per priority (sostituisce `left.number - right.number`).

- All-backfill iniziale priority=index+1 → ordine identico al pre-migrazione (nessun cambiamento visivo).

- Caricamento piano → Work Tree ordina per priority (verificare con priorities forzate).
- `pnpm check` verde.

---
**Completion summary:**
dashboard-tree.ts buildWorkTree: tasks sort by priority (tiebreak number→createdAt→title); phases sort by priority (tiebreak number); features sort by priority (tiebreak number→name). Uses (x.priority ?? 0) for safety. Web UI builds clean.

tasks.title: Drag&drop reorder con @dnd-kit (entro stesso scope)
tasks.description:
## File
`packages/plan-web-ui/package.json` (deps), `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx` + `work-tree-rows.tsx`, hook use-dashboard-tree

## Cosa fare
- Aggiungere deps `@dnd-kit/core`, `@dnd-kit/sortable` (MIT).
- Work Tree: wrap righe fratelli (tasks di una phase, phases di una feature, features del project) in `SortableContext` (vertical). Ogni riga è `useSortable({ id: entity.id })`.
- On `DragEnd`: calcola nuovo ordine → chiama `reorder(kind, ids)` API → ricalcola gap 10,20,30. Feedback ottimistico (riordina subito, revert on error).
- Drag handle visibile (icona grip `lucide-react GripVertical`), tap-target ≥44px mobile.
- Disabilitare DnD su righe matchate dalla search (o manterlo attivo — decidi: attivo sempre).

## Note
- Riordino solo entro stesso scope (no cross-phase/task spostamento).
- WebSocket reorder event → refresh live (altro client vede il riordino).

## Verify
- Drag task A sopra task B → ordine persiste dopo reload.
- Puppeteer 390px: drag handle ≥44px, 0 overflow.
- `pnpm check` verde.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added @dnd-kit/core + @dnd-kit/sortable + @dnd-kit/utilities to plan-web-ui. New sortable.tsx (SortableItem + DragHandle via context). work-tree.tsx: DndContext (PointerSensor distance 5) + SortableContext around features list + handleDragEnd (determines scope feature/phase/task, arrayMove, calls reorder API). work-tree-rows.tsx: SortableContext around phases (per feature) and tasks (per phase); DragHandle in each row badge row. CSS .drag-handle + .ap-sortable--dragging. WS broadcast auto-revalidates via live-sync. Verified API reorder semantics: ids in desired order → priority (index+1)*10, GET returns priority-sorted. Web UI + pnpm check green. web-ui-dist synced to pi-adapter + plan-server.

tasks.title: Search bar elastic-input (autosuggest scope + filtri Work Tree)
tasks.description:
## File
`packages/plan-web-ui/package.json` (dep `elastic-input`), nuovo `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/search-bar.tsx`, `packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts`, `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx`

## Cosa fare
- Aggiungere dep `elastic-input` (MIT).
- Nuovo `SearchBar` component con `<ElasticInput>`:
  - `fields`: feature(number), phase(number), task(number), status(string enum: planned/in-progress/done/blocked/...), title(string), id(string=shortId).
  - `fetchSuggestions(field, partial)`: per feature/phase/task → number presenti nel piano (formattati); per id → shortId presenti (prefix match); per title → titoli via substring; per status → enum.
  - `onSearch(query, ast)` → parser AST → produce `{ featureNumbers?, phaseNumbers?, taskNumbers?, status?, text?, shortIds? }`.
- `useDashboardTree`: aggiungere `searchFilters` state + `matchedTaskIds` derivato; `displayedWorkTree` filtrato a rami contenenti match + auto-expand feature/phase matchati.
- `work-tree.tsx`: posizionare SearchBar sopra il Work Tree; highlight match (ring accent) sulle righe matchate; conteggio "N match".
- Comma-list `task:10,12,3`: parsare il value dal AST → array di numeri.

## Note
- Filtri status esistenti in AND con search.
- Search vuota → tree normale.
- Mobile: input full-width, dropdown sopra l'albero.

## Verify
- search `id:UUXD1` → 1 match evidenziato, albero collassato a quel ramo.
- search `task:10,12,3` → 3 match.
- search `title:auth` → match substring sui titoli.
- Puppeteer 390px: 0 overflow, dropdown leggibile.
- `pnpm check` verde.

---
**Completion summary:**
elastic-input integrated. task-search.ts (parser+matcher), useDashboardTree (search state + matched sets + displayedWorkTree override), SearchBar component (6 fields + fetchSuggestions), WorkTree wiring (auto-expand + match count + highlight), TaskTreeRow ap-search-hit. Verified parser semantics. pnpm check green. web-ui-dist synced.

---
**Completion summary:**
Search bar fixes from user testing on :3030: (1) placeholder centered via .ei-placeholder padding 8px 12px; (2) keybindings Ctrl-H (char del via API), Ctrl-U (word del via API), Ctrl-J/K (suggestion nav via redispatch ArrowDown/Up) — elastic-input attaches onKeyDown to the contentEditable editor itself, handled via e.currentTarget + ElasticInputAPI inputRef; (3) feature-status: and phase-status: search keys (status: stays task-only); (4) empty field: edge case guarded in parser; (5) sticky Work Tree search+filter bar with measured header offset (ResizeObserver); (6) removed redundant Feature/Phase/Task status filter chips from Work Tree (now covered by search). All verified via Puppeteer. pnpm check green.

tasks.title: Work Tree follow-up: remove Show-all button, fix expand/collapse with filter, placeholder align, mobile compact, sticky scroll-out
tasks.description:
Follow-up fixes from user testing of the sticky search/filter Work Tree bar:

1. Remove "Show all features" button from the Work Tree header (the search bar + filters now cover that role; showAllFeatures state stays at default true, only "Only active branches" toggle remains). File: packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx (header button group ~L70-78).

2. Expand/Collapse all don't work while an elastic-input search is active. Root cause: in work-tree.tsx the expanded prop is `expandedFeatureIds.includes(id) || (searchActive && matchedFeatureIds.has(id))` — matched nodes are FORCE-expanded during search, so Collapse all (which clears expandedFeatureIds) has no effect, and Expand all is a no-op (already expanded). Fix: remove the forced `|| (searchActive && matched*)` clauses in work-tree.tsx; add an effect in use-dashboard-tree.ts that, when searchActive/matched sets change, sets treeOpenMode="smart" + expandedFeatureIds=matchedFeatureIds + expandedPhaseIds=matchedPhaseIds so matched nodes expand once and the user can collapse them (and Collapse all works). Files: work-tree.tsx (isPhaseExpanded + expanded prop), use-dashboard-tree.ts (new effect near the existing expand effect).

3. Placeholder still slightly too low. Current CSS .search-bar .ei-placeholder { padding: 8px 12px } over-corrects. Measure the ei-editor real padding-top and align the placeholder exactly (likely 6-7px or flex centering). File: packages/plan-web-ui/src/styles/base.css.

4. Mobile: Reset filters / Repair plan buttons take too much vertical room; little space left to read the tree. Compact the filter bar on mobile: reduce px-4 py-4 → px-3 py-2, smaller gaps, make Reset/Repair compact (text-xs, less padding) and hide/truncate repairMsg. File: work-tree.tsx (filter bar div + buttons).

5. Sticky filter bar scrolls out of view when a filter is changed (content shrinks → sticky unsticks → bar snaps back up). Diagnose with Puppeteer (scroll then toggle a filter, measure sticky top). Candidate fix: give the WorkTree Card a min-height so the sticky bar keeps a stick range even when the tree shrinks; or bound the tree list with internal overflow. Decide after measuring. Files: work-tree.tsx + base.css.

Verify all via Puppeteer on :3030. pnpm check green. Commit to feat/shortid-priority-dnd.

---
**Completion summary:**
All 5 follow-up fixes implemented and verified via Puppeteer on :3030:

1. Removed "Show all features" button from Work Tree header (search bar + filters cover that role; only "Only active" toggle remains).

2. Fixed Expand/Collapse all not working during a search: removed the forced `|| (searchActive && matched*)` expansion in work-tree.tsx (isPhaseExpanded + expanded prop); added a search-driven effect in useDashboardTree that sets treeOpenMode="smart" + expandedFeatureIds/PhaseIds = matched sets when search is active, so matched branches expand once and the user can collapse them. Verified: search→15 task links, Collapse all→0, Expand all→15.

3. Placeholder vertical alignment: changed .ei-placeholder padding from 8px 12px to 0 12px (the box is already at the editor's text line; 8px top padding pushed it 8px too low). Verified delta=0, horizontal 12px matches editor.

4. Mobile compact filter bar: Reset/Repair buttons use !min-h-9 !text-xs on mobile (38px) and sm:!min-h-11 sm:text-sm on desktop (44px); shorter labels; px-3 py-2 on mobile; repairMsg hidden on mobile. Filter bar 154px→92px, tree 409px, 0 overflow.

5. Replaced position:sticky filter bar (unsticks when tree shrinks after a filter change) with a bounded internal-scroll tree container (.ap-tree-scroll, maxHeight=calc(100dvh - headerH - 220px)). Search+filter bar sits above the scroll container and stays visible while the tree scrolls internally. Verified tree scrolls (1725>524), filter bar top unchanged (976) during internal scroll.

Files: packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx, src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts, src/styles/base.css. pnpm check green. Committed to feat/shortid-priority-dnd.
